events.verdict: Wembanyama (SAS) firms up over his right leg in a screening position in Achiuwa's (NYK) path.
Achiuwa (NYK) legally contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Bridges (NYK) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot prior to releasing the ball to start his dribble.
Achiuwa (NYK) firms up in Paul's (SAS) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Paul (SAS) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) reaches in and avoids making illegal contact with Jones (SAS) during his drive towards the basket.
Brunson (NYK) moves alongside Jones' (SAS) path and marginal contact occurs during Jones' driving shot attempt.

Sochan (SAS) brings his left hand towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Hart (NYK) during the rebounding opportunity. As Sochan returns to the floor, he comes into contact with his teammate, Wembanyama (SAS).
Paul (SAS) makes contact with Hart's (NYK) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Sochan (SAS) and Achiuwa (NYK) come together and engage during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Achiuwa (NYK) legally contests Paul's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Sochan (SAS) brings his hand towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Brunson's (NYK) right arm prior to New York being awarded a timeout.
Prior to Brunson (NYK) falling out of bounds while in possession of the ball, the Knicks signal for and are awarded a timeout.
Brunson (NYK) establishes the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Jones (SAS) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Paul (SAS) and Anunoby (NYK) come together at the same spot on the floor as they pursue the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
Jones (SAS) brings his right hand towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Brunson's (NYK) arm while he is in possession of the ball.
Vassell (SAS) legally contests Anunoby's (NYK) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Bridges (NYK) brings his right hand to the ball and legally deflects it away from Sochan (SAS) prior to incidental arm contact occurring during the rebounding opportunity.
Sochan (SAS) brings his right hand towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Hart (NYK) as he secures the rebounding opportunity and loses his balance on his own accord.
